name: UB quoting accuracy benchmark
about: Each question has gold paragraph(s) confirmed with ub-search.js --ref. 'expect' is a fact a correct answer must state (matched on words, punctuation and case ignored). Several questions target the exact failure types found in Urantia Book Network articles on 2026-09-23: Bible wording substituted for UB wording, dropped words, wrong paragraph numbers and wrong figures. Q20/Q21 separate two Van and Amadon spans that are easy to conflate: the staff arrived about 500,000 years ago (66:0.2); Van and Amadon were sustained by the tree of life and Melchizedek ministry for over 150,000 years (67:6.4); they stayed until shortly after Adam and Eve arrived (67:6.8), and the whole physical regime lasted more than 450,000 years (76:5.6). accept: equivalent statements of the same fact earn the fact point (the quote point still requires exact wording).

questions.expect: I am the vine, and you are the branches
questions.question: In The Urantia Book, what does Jesus say about the vine and the branches in his farewell discourse? Quote the passage.

questions.expect: while he was yet afar off
questions.question: In The Urantia Book's telling of the parable of the lost son, what did the father see and do as the son approached home? Quote the exact words.

According to The Urantia Book, how many of the original 50,000 primary midwayers joined the Caligastia secession? Quote the passage.
According to The Urantia Book, how many loyal secondary midwayers are there? Quote the passage.
What name does The Urantia Book give to the final outbreak of the Lucifer rebellion, and how was the rebels' cause stated? Quote the passage.

questions.expect: stereotyped systems of Urantia religious beliefs
questions.question: What did Immanuel advise Michael about leaving writings or images behind on Urantia, and why? Quote the passage from The Urantia Book.
According to The Urantia Book, upon what must Thought Adjusters do all their work? Quote the passage.
